title: Papa Tio and Lorenzo Tio as teachers; lessons from Big Eye Louis
summary: The interviewers talk about Papa Tio's pupils; Burbank took a few lessons from Big Eye Louis Nelson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Did you hear any of his other folks, his uncle or father, Lorenzo or Papa, Teo, did you ever hear them play? Come on up there, Tony. Oh, I don't think I ever, I don't think I ever heard the old man play.

It was before your time, right? That was before my time, yeah. And had I, well, I don't remember when did he die, but I don't believe he was dead yet, you know, when I was trying to get somebody to teach me if I could do anything about him. Probably I'd have been able to get him.
Because Papa, Teo was a teacher quite a bit. Yeah, he had a lot of scholars. He taught some of those, Albert Nicholas too.
Yeah, I think he taught Bonnie Begard.
Yeah, I think Albert Nicholas, no, three or four. Even Big Eye Louie, I believe, took some lessons from Papa, Teo. Yeah. I think Big Eye taught him.
I took a few lessons from Big Eye Louie.
Well, you took some from him too. Yeah. I understand he never did use music so much, he had a wonderful ear. Did he teach you how to book though too, or just?
